column3: Each space in the home snapshot carries requestsRev, bumped in the workspace projection whenever a conversation's set of open request ids changes; it is in memory, max(rev+1, Date.now()) from the boot time, and the web re-reads request.list only when it moves. The inferred key (openRequests, waiting thread ids, pending ids in the top-5 home window) is gone
column4: XIN-23 medium: a thread answered and asked again while five newer requests from other spaces filled the home window left the inferred key unchanged, so Q2 was never listed. Bosun chose a per-space counter. In memory over a stored rev because the projection already sees every xin.requests commit and reads every requests doc at boot, so the counter costs no row read or write per open, resolve or snapshot; flooring at Date.now() (the plugins/automations precedent) keeps it from repeating across eviction, and an eviction alone moves it once, which costs one request.list on reconnect
column5: plugins/workspace/workspace.test.ts (rev moves on open, resolve and re-ask, per space, not for thread status, and rises across evictDurableObject); web/src/lib/requests.test.ts (re-ask with a full window from another space: one request.list on the held frame and on a reconnect snapshot; 2 of 5 fail when keyed on count and waiting ids)
